I've spent nearly two decades in supply chain — building, leading, and learning what it actually takes to create change in this industry.
 
Today, I'm the Founder & CEO of Let's Talk Supply Chain™, a global media platform and top 1% podcast dedicated to the leaders, innovators, and operators shaping the future of supply chain and logistics. I also host Thoughts & Coffee, a weekly LinkedIn Live breaking down the biggest stories in the industry.
 
But the work that means the most to me is the work that started with a simple belief: everyone deserves to be heard.
 
That belief is behind everything I build. The Blended podcast and Blended Pledge nonprofit are focused on increasing diverse representation on stages and in leadership. The Secret Society of Supply Chain community brings professionals together for real conversation, not just networking.
 
I'm also a LinkedIn Learning instructor and the author of the #1 Amazon Best Seller "I Buried Her in a French Press" — a memoir about identity, losing your voice, and the long road to getting it back.
 
My content focuses on supply chain leadership, entrepreneurship, and the role self-worth plays in how we lead, decide, and show up. If you're a supply chain professional, entrepreneur, or leader who believes that people-first leadership drives better outcomes — you're in the right place.
 
Let's connect. I'd love to hear your story.

Are you seeking ways to revolutionize your marketing and operations?

Feeling the need to scale your business but unsure if you're fully prepared?

Uncertain about your marketing funnel's performance and how to enhance it?

Keep reading, because we have the solution.

At Nxt Lvl Scaling, we specialize in leveraging the power of AI to transform your marketing and operations. Our AI-powered tools are designed to amplify your marketing efforts, including intelligent forms, email campaigns, SMS campaigns, and advanced reporting tools. On the operations side, we develop customized AI-powered workflows to streamline your business operations, making them smoother and more efficient than ever before.

In my experience working with clients in the marketing and operations automation space, I've observed a common pattern. This pattern often holds even the most successful business owners back from embracing the next level of growth.

Pattern #1: Fear of Change - New ventures can be intimidating, and many prioritize safety over success. However, this fear hinders growth more than anything else.

Pattern #2: Generalist Thinking - Not focusing on specific solutions tailored to address precise organizational challenges. To foster innovation, it's essential to dive deep into your organization's exact problems and develop creative strategies accordingly. For instance, "How do we improve our marketing?" vs. "How can we achieve a 10% increase in qualified leads to meet our sales goals?"

Pattern #3: Systems - Failing to establish a reliable system that consistently attracts the right leads, fulfills their needs, and capitalizes on their satisfaction. In today's landscape, automation is crucial for delivering a consistently exceptional client experience. Manual-driven processes alone won't suffice beyond 2023.

The good news is, these patterns are entirely avoidable and can be addressed with the right attention and systems.

At Nxt Lvl Scaling, we are obsessed with delivering results, and we're excited to help you achieve yours. If you're curious to learn more, feel free to reach out via direct message.

Forget the typical sales pitch. Let's have a genuine conversation about your needs and explore how we can help you thrive. I respond promptly, so don't hesitate to DM me.

I spend my working hours making sure the right product is in the right place at the right time - Replenishment at Tetra Pak. The kind of operational complexity that looks straightforward on a slide, but isn't in reality.  

Supply chain decisions go wrong not because the data wasn't there. They go wrong because of how decisions get made, who makes them, what they're measuring, and what never makes it into the room in the first place.  

That gap is why I started Shetty's Desk. A how-to for supply chain, one real topic at a time, made accessible for anyone who wants to understand how the industry actually works and why decisions get made the way they do.  

Outside of operations: DE&I Europe Panelist, Culture Champion at Tetra Pak. I believe the same thing about inclusion that I believe about supply chains. The information exists. The gap is always in the translation and execution.  

"I may not be a scientist, but some of the previous years experiments have yielded positive results." (Trial and error, they call it.)

Before founding her consultancy, Sue spent 15 years lecturing in Business and Computing—an experience that continues to shape her passion for data literacy and enabling others.

Her current focus includes Microsoft Fabric, semantic modelling, and automating analytics using Python and DAX. She regularly speaks at major data conferences including SQLBits, Microsoft-led events, and other industry gatherings. Sue also runs her own weekly tech user group, co-hosts the fortnightly Unpivot podcast, and actively contributes to the data community by sharing practical insights that demystify complex tools and help others embrace data with clarity and confidence.

When she’s not building reports or wrangling data, Sue’s often found training for marathons, running long distances across the Devon coast, walking her dog, or championing women in tech spaces.

items.about:
I’m Susan Walsh, also known as The Classification Guru, a globally recognised expert in spend data classification, cleaning, and transformation. For over a decade, I’ve helped organisations fix dirty, unreliable data and turn it into insight they can actually trust.

In 2017, I founded The Classification Guru Ltd, rebuilding my career from the ground up after coming back from bankruptcy after my first business failed. What started as a solo consultancy has grown into a specialist business supporting 100+ organisations globally, particularly in procurement, sales, and marketing, where clean data underpins reporting, automation, and AI.

I work with mid-sized and enterprise organisations, consultancies, and technology providers that rely on complex, high-volume data but struggle with inconsistency, duplication, and poor structure. My clients include procurement, finance, sales, and marketing teams who need data they can stand behind, whether that’s for spend analysis, supplier management, CRM reporting, forecasting, compliance, or AI initiatives.

Keeping a business alive and growing for almost nine years hasn’t been about shortcuts or hype. It’s been built through real-world delivery, practical problem-solving, and a refusal to accept “good enough” data as acceptable. Along the way, I’ve developed frameworks and tools to help organisations embed sustainable data quality, including the COAT framework (Consistent, Organised, Accurate, Trustworthy) and Samification, a self-service supplier normalisation platform launched in 2024 to make clean, structured data accessible at scale.

I’m also an active contributor to the wider data and business community. I’m a TEDx speaker, international conference speaker, and recognised thought leader in data quality and classification. I’ve authored three books, including Between the Spreadsheets 1st and 2nd editions, and the upcoming Optimizing Sales and Marketing. I teach globally via platforms such as Pluralsight, O’Reilly, and the Analytics Institute. Through consistent, practical thought leadership, I’ve grown an engaged LinkedIn audience of 43,000+ professionals.

Alongside my commercial work, I founded the Women Who Speak LinkedIn group, a free initiative connecting women speakers with event organisers to improve visibility and representation. I hope my journey shows that you don’t have to fit a mould to build a credible business, lead in your field, or create meaningful impact.

My mission is simple: help organisations move from spreadsheet chaos to clean, organised, trustworthy data that actually works.
items.headline: Dirty data doesn’t fix itself. Fortunately, I do | Founder, The Classification Guru | LinkedIn Learning instructor | 2x author | Speaker | TEDx | Creator of Samification™ & COAT

currentPosition.description:
Founder of The Classification Guru Ltd (est. 2017), a specialist data consultancy helping organisations clean, classify, and trust their data before it reaches reporting, transformation, automation, or AI.

We work with procurement, finance, sales, and marketing teams to fix messy supplier, spend, and commercial data through structured classification, normalisation, taxonomy design, and governance frameworks. To date, we’ve supported over 90 organisations globally in turning chaotic datasets into commercially usable assets.

At the core of our approach is the COAT framework: Consistent, Organised, Accurate, and Trustworthy. It’s a practical methodology that ensures data quality improvements are sustainable, not just one-off clean-ups.

In 2024, we launched Samification, our self-service supplier normalisation tool, designed to standardise business names quickly, securely, and at scale. Backed by a master list of over 600,000 cleaned supplier names, with one third already classified, Samification extends our consultancy expertise into scalable product delivery.

Alongside client work, I lead thought leadership through books, speaking, and training, helping organisations understand that clean data is not a technical nice-to-have. It is the foundation of trust, insight, and better decision-making.

www.theclassficationguru.com
